user.title: Connect to ioDek
user.description: Create an API key in ioDek under Account → API keys. The read permission is required; add charge, comfort, access or signal to control the car.

data_description.url: Leave the default unless you use another ioDek instance.
data_description.api_key: Starts with vigie_ (shown once at creation).

vehicles.title: Cars
vehicles.description: Choose the cars to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: ioDek at {url} refused the key (revoked or expired). Enter a new one.

error.missing_read: This key lacks the read permission.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach ioDek at this address.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
error.no_vehicles: No car on this ioDek account.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with https://

abort.already_configured: This ioDek account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This key belongs to another account: none of the configured cars is visible.

data.location_entity: Position sent to ioDek (away mode for climate)
data.exposed_entities: Entities for the ioDek dashboard buttons

data_description.scan_interval: 30 to 300 seconds. Reads are free; the limit is 60 per minute per key.
data_description.signal_buttons: Turn on only if the key has the signal permission. ioDek cannot report it without sounding the horn.
data_description.location_entity: A person or device tracker. Leave empty to send nothing. ioDek keeps only the last position, for 24 h at most. The key needs the position permission.
data_description.exposed_entities: Entities that the ioDek dashboard buttons can operate. The key needs the home automation permission.

bridge_ability_missing.title: ioDek refuses the dashboard buttons
bridge_ability_missing.description: The API key lacks the home automation permission, so the ioDek dashboard buttons can no longer operate Home Assistant. Add the home automation permission to the key in ioDek (Account → API keys), then reload the integration or change its options.

bridge_plan_required.title: Dashboard buttons need an ioDek plan
bridge_plan_required.description: Your ioDek plan does not include API access, so the ioDek dashboard buttons can no longer operate Home Assistant. Change your plan in ioDek, then reload the integration or change its options.

location_ability_missing.title: ioDek refuses the position
location_ability_missing.description: The API key lacks the position permission, so the position of {entity} is no longer sent. Add the permission to the key in ioDek (Account → API keys), then reload the integration or change its options.

location_disabled.title: Position turned off in ioDek
location_disabled.description: The use of your position is turned off in the ioDek app, so the position of {entity} is no longer sent. Turn it back on in ioDek, then reload the integration, or clear the entity in the options.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Reads the latest data from ioDek now. Free, does not wake the car.

device_id.name: Cars
device_id.description: Cars to refresh. All when empty.

rate_limited.message: ioDek limit reached, try again shortly.

vehicle_not_found.message: This car is no longer visible with this key.

read_forbidden.message: The key no longer has the read permission.

vehicle_asleep.message: The car is asleep. Press Wake up first (3 per hour).

ability_missing.message: The API key lacks the permission for this command: {message}

option_disabled.message: This option is off for the car in ioDek: {message}
